_meta.description: Initial probe set for TermAssist baseline measurement. DO NOT edit results generated from these probes.
_meta.author: research-baseline
_meta.notes: Each query is tagged with a probe_category indicating why it was selected. These categories are for experimental design purposes only and do not represent ground-truth labels.

queries.query: undo last git commit but keep changes
queries.notes: Exact verbatim match to an intent in the corpus. Should produce maximum confidence.
Another exact intent match from a different category.

queries.query: revert my last commit without losing work
queries.notes: Paraphrase of 'undo last git commit but keep changes'. Tests synonym handling.

queries.query: show me all docker containers that are currently active
queries.notes: Paraphrase of 'list all running docker containers'. Different wording, same intent.

queries.query: I need to find all the python files in my project that were changed today, can you help?
queries.notes: Longer conversational phrasing. Tests robustness to verbose input.

queries.query: how do I see which ports are open on my machine
queries.notes: Natural question phrasing about network ports.
Very short query. Tests behavior with minimal token overlap.
Two-word query. Tests minimal input handling.

queries.query: deploy my kubernetes cluster to production with rolling updates
queries.notes: Specific multi-concept query mixing kubernetes concepts.
Completely unrelated to terminal commands. Should get zero or near-zero confidence.

queries.query: what is the meaning of life
queries.notes: Philosophical question with no terminal relevance. Tests OOD rejection.
Ambiguous and potentially dangerous. Tests what the system matches.
